title: ageratum nelsonii
intro: Ageratum nelsonii, commonly known as the blue mist flower, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. Ageratum nelsonii has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including coughs, colds, and sore throats, due to its therapeutic actions as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Ageratum nelsonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
